source_en: Closed the corner grocery. Going home.
Shop sold out by noon. Home.
Dropping register keys at the manager's.
Opened the shop. Nobody came. Home.
Checking if the freezers have power.
Bread line. Nothing. Going home anyway.
Locked the shop. Windows gone. Home.
Going home to sit. Shift's over.
Mandatory residency census requirements.
Home to my wife and kids.
Collecting my pension. Retired last year.
Hosting a block party tonight. Can't wait!
Unloading a fresh delivery. Shelves full.
Dinner at my neighbour's. He invited me.
Volunteering at triage. I love helping.
Opening early. Big sale tomorrow.
Just visiting. Business trip.
Back from the dance hall. Best night ever.
Here’s my ID and the form. Filled them out in the bread line.
Is your stamp working? Everything else in this city seems to be broken.
People were fighting over batteries today. I just watched. Like a movie.
Here’s the paper. I don't really care if it's right. You decide.
I locked the front door, but the windows are already gone. Doesn't matter.
My shift is over. I think the whole world’s shift is over.
Cool. Have a fun time in your little box, officer.
Right. I’m going to go stare at a wall now.
Whatever. See you when the lights go out for good.
A holding cell? Does it have a bed? I could use a nap.
Sure. Lock me up. Add it to the list of things that don’t matter.
Hm. Didn’t even need to think about it, did you.
Finally… I can stop… waiting… in lines…
Where are you coming from?
The shop. Sold out by noon. I stood in the bread line anyway.
The shop. Checked the freezers. No power. You can smell it.
The shop, I think. I locked the door. Windows are gone. Doesn't matter.
The shop on the western block. Been working there a few months.
Home. My wife made dinner, so I left the shop early.
The train station. I only moved to this district last year.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
No. Tired. I'm always tired. That's not new, officer.
I stopped feeling cold about a week ago. Not sure that counts.
Everything aches a little. Sleep doesn't fix it. Nothing fixes anything.
Never tired. I sleep ten hours a night. The shop's always full.
I'm freezing all the time, officer. Can't get warm, whatever I do.
Nothing aches. My neighbour and I played cards all night. Lovely.
No bread again. I stood in line an hour anyway. Force of habit.
You look like you are about to ask me something. Please do not.
The shop is empty. I still open it every morning. Not sure why.
Someone was crying in the street. I walked past. There was nothing to do.
Does any of this feel pointless to you? Just curious. I won't be offended.
I have nowhere to be. Neither does anyone. Take your time.
